messages:
Jess (marketing): Quick sync — planning a small content launch: 'Lightweight Playbooks' series: 3 short tutorials (refapp walkthru), 1 companion benchmark post, + a 45m webinar with live demo. Dates: draft posts by Mon 5/10, publish week of 5/20, webinar Thu 5/23. Need owners for launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar host, and lead routing. Thoughts?
Mike (devrel): Love it. I can host the webinar demo. I'll demo the refapp and a quick perf run. Question: target audience — platform engineers vs app devs?
Tanya (prod-marketing): Target = app devs + infra/platform leads. Messaging should emphasize 'production-ready with minimal ops'. Focus on cost/latency tradeoffs. I'll draft a headline and 3 CTAs.
Li (eng): I can produce a small benchmark script + dataset. Bench will compare default vs prefix/KV caching on 8k context. Artifacts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/lightplaybook/bench ETA Tue.
Ana (growth): For inbound routing we need UTM + lead tags. Suggest campaign=lightplaybooks, source=webinar, content=refapp. Also want an email nurture with 3 touches. Who owns the form?
Jess (marketing): Ana — can you own the form + GTM tags? Mike — thanks for hosting. Li — can you deliver bench by Tue EOD? Tanya — draft headline + 2 subject lines?
Mike (devrel): Yep I'll host. Also need a one-liner explaining what the demo will show for the landing page. Idea: 'Build and ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower cost — in 20 minutes.'
Tanya (prod-marketing): Drafts: Headline: 'Lightweight Playbooks: Production LLMs without the heavy ops' Subject lines: 1) 'Ship LLM features that scale — webinar 5/23' 2) 'Benchmark-backed tips to cut inference cost'
Li (eng): Bench snippet for post: ```bash
python bench.py --model redwood-llama-8k --cache-prefix on --batch 8 > results.csv
``` Will include perf table and p95 token latency graph.
Ana (growth): For routing, add hidden field on form: campaign=lightplaybooks, utm_medium=email, tag=webinar_lightplaybooks. I'll create the nurture sequence and request the webinar attendee list.
event-bot: Calendar event 'Lightweight Playbooks — webinar' created by Mike on 2025-05-23T16:00Z :calendar:
Jess (marketing): Nice. Action items: Mike host/demo + calendar (assigned), Li bench + artifacts, Tanya landing copy + post draft, Ana form + nurture. I'll draft the launch post outline and ping design for hero screenshot. Check back here by Tue EOD with links. :rocket:
Mike (devrel): I'll upload demo repo to /internal/devrel/refapps and add demo notes.
Tanya (prod-marketing): I'll post hooks for social: 3 tweets + LinkedIn post. Draft coming tonight.
Li (eng): Uploaded bench CSV to the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/lightplaybook/bench/results.csv
Jess (marketing): Perfect — thanks team. If nobody objects I'll lock dates and start scheduling CTAs. :thumbsup:
